customtitleicon.configuration.pack.toolt: Modpack details, used by the {packname} and {packversion} title variables.
customtitleicon.configuration.pack.name: Name
customtitleicon.configuration.title: Window Title
customtitleicon.configuration.title.tool:
Window title for each game state.
Variables: {packname}, {packversion}, {mcversion}, {neoforge}, {modcount}, {username}, {world}, {server}, {address}, {modversion:<modid>}.
Unknown variables are shown as written.
customtitleicon.configuration.title.defa: Title in the menus. Leave empty to keep the vanilla title.
customtitleicon.configuration.title.sing: Title in a singleplayer world, including one opened to LAN. Empty uses the default title.
customtitleicon.configuration.title.mult: Title on a server or in a LAN world of another player. Empty uses the default title.
customtitleicon.configuration.title.show: Fill {address} with the server address. When off, {address} is empty, which is safer for streaming.
customtitleicon.configuration.icon.toolt: Window icon. Not supported on macOS and Wayland, where the setting is ignored.
Square PNG with transparency, relative to the config folder. 256x256 or 512x512 is recommended.
Sizes 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 are generated from it. A file next to it named like icon-16.png is used for that size instead of a generated one.
Leave empty to keep the vanilla icon.
customtitleicon.configuration.titlebar.t: Title bar look on Windows. Ignored on other systems.

system follows the Windows setting for apps (light or dark), light and dark force one.
Needs Windows 10 version 1809 or newer.
customtitleicon.configuration.titlebar.c: Title bar background as #RRGGBB. Empty uses the system color. Windows 11 only.
customtitleicon.configuration.titlebar.t: Title text as #RRGGBB. Empty uses the system color. Windows 11 only.
customtitleicon.configuration.titlebar.b: Window border as #RRGGBB. Empty uses the system color. Windows 11 only.
customtitleicon.configuration.window.too: Game window. Size settings take effect at the next start and are skipped in fullscreen.
customtitleicon.configuration.window.fla: Flash the taskbar button when the game has finished loading and the window is in the background.
Flash the taskbar button when a server disconnects or kicks you and the window is in the background.
customtitleicon.configuration.window.ini: Window width when no saved size is used. 0 keeps the default width.
Window height when no saved size is used. 0 keeps the default height.
customtitleicon.configuration.window.sta: Start with a maximized window when no saved size is used.
customtitleicon.configuration.window.rem:
Remember the window size, position and maximized state between starts.
Saved in customtitleicon/window-state.json in the game folder, next to the config and mods folders.
